title.narrative: Network Activity - DSU and SD Platform

description.narrative: To sustain and strengthen our bonds of partnership and cooperation, DSU would like to invite our partners from SD Platform to partake in DSU’s national congress, which is scheduled for May 10-12. This will serve as a way for us to hold physical meetings regarding our collaboration on our extensive partnership. We also aim for this network activity to provide SD Platform with insights on the organizational build-up of DSU, which can be helpful for them in their own organizational development. SD Platform’s participation at the DSU national congress will be a prime occasion for our organizations to strengthen social relations, establish connections between members of our organizations and to develop closer ties.
